CREATE TABLE "public"."BusLayout" (
  "busId" text NOT NULL,
  "columnCount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "rowCount" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bus_layout_dimensions_e07be16e" CHECK ("rowCount" BETWEEN 2 AND 51 AND "columnCount" BETWEEN 3 AND 8)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BusLayoutCell" (
  "column" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "layoutId" text NOT NULL,
  "row" int4 NOT NULL,
  "seatId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "BusLayoutCell_kind_check_2cef50ca" CHECK ("kind" IN ('SEAT', 'AISLE', 'DRIVER', 'DOOR', 'EMPTY')),
  CONSTRAINT "bus_layout_cell_coordinates_163905df" CHECK (row BETWEEN 0 AND 50 AND "column" BETWEEN 0 AND 7),
  CONSTRAINT "bus_layout_cell_seat_5946a95f" CHECK ((kind = 'SEAT' AND "seatId" IS NOT NULL) OR (kind <> 'SEAT' AND "seatId" IS NULL))
)
